bioconda.name: amfsplit
bioconda.summary: Name long-read AMF rDNA sequences across MaarjAM VT, UNITE SH and LSU species clades, with measured novelty

commands: printf '>w1\nACGTTGCATGCCTAGGCTAACGTTAGCCGATCGATTACGGCATCGATCGGATCGTAGCTAGCTAGGCTTACGATCGG\n' > w.fa && amfsplit validate -w w.fa -r w.fa -o smoke --threads 1 && test -s smoke.hits.tsv
